recipes.name: Microwave Scalloped Potatoes
ingredients_raw: 0.5 teaspoon dried parsley, or to taste
1 pinch ground paprika, or to taste

steps.text: Place potatoes, onion, and butter in a large microwave-safe dish.
Mix flour and salt in a bowl; sprinkle over potatoes and gently toss until vegetables are coated.
Cook in the microwave on high setting until potatoes are tender, about 15 minutes, stirring every 5 minutes.
Allow potatoes to rest for 5 minutes before sprinkling with parsley and paprika for serving.

raw_recipe.headline: Microwave Scalloped Potatoes
raw_recipe.description: Cooking these creamy potatoes in the microwave saves time and also frees up your oven for cooking the main dish.

review.reviewBody: Awesome, quick and easy! Added cheese per suggestions. Allrecipes needs to quit with the footnote tips about aluminum foil when it comes to microwave recipes.. You never know, somone's going to be dumb enough to do it.

Excellent. Used slicing blade on food processor to make slicing potatoes a breeze. Ended up with uniform slices. Used 2 t salt as written. Tossed with 2 T flour. Melted 4 T butter and mixed it in (we like butter!) Used heavy cream instead of milk. Easy and so much faster than oven method. This one is a keeper.

It is lovely but changed around a bit. 
Potatoes 4, sliced in a microwave dish, added onion sliced,
 Cream instead of milk, 1 pkt maggi soup I used onion mixed in the cream poured over top and then put chives on top with a little grated cheese. I can not drink milk so that is why used cream. Cooked 15 min in microwave and was so creamy and yummy.

The recipe is nice, but took much longer. Per other suggestions, I added 2 T more butter, 1/4 tsp garlic salt, 1 c chopped ham and 1 cup grated cheddar. I sliced just two large potatoes very thin, and the potatoes still weren't done after 25 minutes. I added 2 more T. of flour because the milk still seemed soupy. Finally, I put the potaotes in the oven for 15 minutes more and they were done. Maybe it's because I didn't cover the potatoes in the micro. I don't have a glass lid, and don't cover anything with plastic. Oh, well, it turned out really good, thank you for the recipe.

Simple and delicious. Easy to expand and easy to cook in the microwave. Used more potatoes (9), added 2 cups cubed ham from leftovers, added 1/4 tsp black pepper, 2 cups soy milk as 2 of the family have milk allergies. Mmmmmm

Love this...(Finally figured out to avoid boil over)...I do not use optional items, but add cubed ham for additional flavor. I microwave UNCOVERED for about 5 mins. on high power (1000 watt oven), stir, then micro 5 mins. more at 70% power; stir again and micro 5 mins. +/-longer at 60% power. This way, there is no splatter or boil over for me.

I only added one teaspoon plus a bit more of salt. It took 25 minutes in the microwave, browned it in the toaster oven on convection for about five minutes. Added a sprinkle of smoked paprika and parsley to the sauce, then more smoked paprika, shredded cheese and panko crumbs to the top, after taking out of microwave. It was delicious.

Thanks so much for this recipe. I followed the recipe exactly except I reduced the salt to 1 tsp. The consistency was perfect with the milk to flour ratio. After it was cooked I sprinkled a couple handfuls of cheddar cheese over the top to melt. It was delicious and I look forward to making these again and adding a few more spices like, black pepper, garlic powder, etc. Love it!

Use half the salt, or less, as others have noted. Otherwise it's good, though without the browning an oven would get you. I'm also thinking you could mix the flour and salt into the very cold milk rather than dredging the potato in it. Might try that next time. Basically nuke it until all the milk is boiled away. For me, that was 100% power for the first 5 minutes, and 80% for the next 10, in order to avoid boil-over spills.
Also, as with most anything like this, after microwaving let the food rest covered for a time equal to the cooking time to permit it to finish cooking and, in this case, absorb any liquid still left.
I cut back a wee bit on the butter and laid a couple of strips of bacon over the top before sticking it in the microwave. Yep I'm Southern LOL but man it gave it some good flavor.

I like to mix the flour salt and milk to make a “batter” and I also add sour cream. After micro, I grate parmigiana reggiano on top and sprinkle plain panko for crunch. Under the broiler for color and bam. Company and guest worthy
I stired it every 10 minutes for 17minutes & I added 2 more potatoes

I am usually a successful cook- but this recipe did not work for me. Potatoes were sliced with a mandolin, so all nice thin, even slices- but my potatoes were in the microwave for 30 minutes and still had a crunchy texture.
Generally very good but recipe could be a little more detailed regarding the butter! Diced? Melted?
This is so easy and delicious, and it's my go-to summertime scalloped potato recipe down here in central Texas.
Served with a ham steak- fast, easy and delicious quick supper ❤️
I slice my potatoes with mandolin and layer them. Between each layer sprinkle flour, chips of butter and parmesan cheese. Pour milk over all Add salt a pepper. micro and done.
It was fast and easy and delicious! I added bacon bits and cheese at the end. It did however take about 10 minutes more than called for and I sliced the potatoes very thin.

Too easy and tasty!!! Creamy! I added some Parmesan that I grated… 1/4 c? I did have an issue with the microwave time needing more minutes…like 15 more. Now I know. I added sliced chopped ham and a bit more onion for my second go round. It will be fabulous.
